about: Floor sketch cards for the 3D house view and scripts/check_house3d.py. The first three were captured from server/workspace.py site_brief (company example data and the public branch). The cards whose id starts fs-live are live-shaped fixtures built from design_live_address.md sections 2.5 and 3 (made-up street names, no lookup made); recorded live cards replace them later. The last three follow the floor plan card contract (FLOORPLAN_SPEC section 3): a large building (building.kind "large", layout.from "none": one ground floor with no rooms, items or runs, water service and sewer outside on the street side), the same at six storeys, and a house whose runs are square and carry risers on three floors. Addresses are made up.
